shared_elements: row of repeated figures along a horizontal register
long horizontal line/band crossing the surface
small isolated dot-like or short-stroke marks
justification: Both surfaces show a horizontal row of small schematic figures beneath or beside a long horizontal line, plus scattered small marks, which is about as generic a correspondence as two unrelated traditions could produce. A depicts recognisable naturalistic animals in profile with modelled bodies (birds of prey, a fox-like predator, a long-necked bird) stacked in carved registers, while B shows frontal stick-like anthropomorphs with splayed arms and legs, rayed heads, a spiral and a comb-like object — different subjects rendered by wholly different conventions.
